thread:
rachel: quick ping 1: PR #812 updates audit-log docs and I accidentally renamed a heading so several anchors broke. legal also asked for clearer retention scope language in the SDK snippets.

omar: link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812. I can fix anchors, but can we settle the exact wording for TTL scope first?

sylvie: saw legal's note. they want the examples to state whether a snippet is tenant-scoped or org/global-scoped. small change but important.

legal-maya: please use this guidance: clearly label each code block as either "tenant-scoped" or "global/admin" and add one concise sentence explaining retention semantics. Avoid casual words like "permanent"; say "indefinite retention may apply under legal hold" if needed.

rachel: got it. proposed micro-pattern in docs: code block header comment + single-line note immediately below the block. keeps page scannable.

omar: will update snippets. proposed tenant JS example: 

```js
// tenant-scoped: set 30-day retention for tenant 'zephyr'
await client.audit.setRetention({ tenantId: 'zephyr', ttlSeconds: 30 * 24 * 3600 }); // 30 days
// Note: this TTL applies to logs collected for the tenant named above.
```

and CLI export redaction example: 

```bash
# export audits and redact IP and email fields
redwood audits export --tenant zephyr --since 2026-08-01 --redact ip,email
```

sylvie: add a tiny sample output showing redaction placeholders so readers understand the transformation e.g. `\{\"user\":\"[REDACTED]\",\"ip\":\"[REDACTED_IP]\"\}`. keeps it explicit.

legal-maya: good. Also add one sentence on private deployments: "Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments may follow customer-managed retention and encryption policies." Exact wording please.

rachel: noted. I'll add that sentence to the compliance/retention page and a short cross-ref link. Also will fix the heading ids so anchors are stable.

omar: small QA ask: use ISO durations in a second example for readability, e.g. `P30D` next to `2592000` so folks can copy whichever they prefer.

sylvie: agree, dual-format is helpful: machine vs human/ISO. but keep examples minimal.

legal-maya: final micro-request: where we mention legal hold, prefer: 'indefinite retention may be required under legal hold' (short and clear).

docs-bot: PR #812 updated by omar  https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/commit123 :white_check_mark:

rachel: I've run linkcheck locally and adjusted headings to use stable ids. pushing now.

omar: pushed updated snippets (tenant vs global labels, ISO comment, redaction example). CI queued.

sylvie: I'll re-run the rendered page preview to confirm the output snippet renders as JSON and the anchors land correctly.

legal-maya: thanks. LGTM pending CI. if anything else changes wording, keep it to one short sentence per place to avoid clutter.

rachel: merging after CI. thanks for quick turnaround. :shipit:
